value: Compared with healthy controls, AD patients showed an increased rightward asymmetry of gray matter in hemispheric I–IV and V of the cerebellum and the lingual gyrus.

AD patients showed a prominent rightward asymmetry in the two regions, whereas healthy controls showed a slight leftward asymmetry in hemispheric I–IV and V of the cerebellum and an approximate left–right symmetry in the lingual gyrus.
These asymmetry alterations were not significantly correlated with daily alcohol intake and dependence duration.
